model: thor::clustering::background: WindowBackground::from_detections over the kept detections, e_false and solve_radii at the window's rule, h = infinity (H_eff = Omega_v W^2 / R^2), W = the rung's window_days
selection: windows whose radius the background solve set and whose kept-detection solve reproduces the dumped radius to SWEEP_FILTER_RADIUS_TOL; drawn at the minimum, 1/3, 2/3 and maximum of their kept density
